title: The Warfighters
description:
S01 E12 — A Soldier's Best Friend
U.S. Army Ranger Trent McDonald becomes renowned for his dog whispering skills; McDonald loses his best friend and military service dog, Benno, on a night raid in Afghanistan in 2012, then his new dog, Layka, gets shot weeks later while saving lives.

title: A Complete History of the Green Berets
description: Tracing the roots of the Green Berets, who were chosen based on intelligence, physical strength and the ability to speak foreign languages.

title: Mail Call
description:
S02 E06 — LAV; Landing Craft; Doughboy; OPFOR; Chain Mail; Military Salute
Light Armored Vehicle; landing craft; World War I Doughboys; training troops; medieval chain mail; the military salute.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E01 — Death Devices
Exploring the dark origin stories behind some of history's most notorious methods of execution, from the guillotine to the electric chair.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E04 — Pain and Punishment
The twisted origin stories of some of history's most diabolically creative and brutal torture devices, from the "Iron Maiden" to the pear of anguish.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E07 — Sinister Spy Weapons
Exploring the dark art of spy-craft, from the Frankenkitty to the umbrella gun; revealing the deadliest spy weapons deployed to gather information and assassinate enemies.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E02 — Temples of Doom
The gates are open to some of history's sinister structures; from the terrifying Tower of London to a hotel of horrors, discovering the dark secrets hidden within these foreboding fortresses.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E03 — Treacherous Traps
Whether they're used to stop treasure hunters, body snatchers, or wartime enemies, booby traps are diabolical devices just waiting to kill.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E06 — Superweapons of Fear
From the world's largest trebuchet to Nazi super cannons, these are the deadly weapons that rain destruction and spread fear on the battlefield.

title: Dark Marvels
description:
S01 E05 — Blades of Fury
From the destructive Viking axe to the sacred but deadly Samurai katana, checking out razor sharp blades wielded by fearsome warriors that have spilled blood and forged empires.

title: Ancient Discoveries
description:
S05 E06 — Impossible Army Machines
The amazing successes and stunning failures of ancient military engineers influence today's weapons and tactics; an ancient Greek weapon is still used on aircraft carriers; rapid-firing Chinese catapult; Hannibal crosses the Alps.

title: Ancient Discoveries
description:
S06 E03 — The Ancient Mega-Fort
Investigating history's most impregnable fortresses; the castle that helped create Great Britain; Cappadocia's invisible underground defensive systems; Mayan killer bee castle defenses; the Roman siege of Alesia in Gaul.

title: Ancient Discoveries
description:
S06 E07 — Ancient Commandos
Ski commandos battle through storms and snow drifts; a tiny army in the Egyptian desert defeats a major invasion force; the Bayeux tapestry; the Naftun.

title: Ancient Discoveries
description:
S06 E04 — Ancient Secret Agents
Ancient secret agents; fire beacons, horses and pigeons are used to transmit messages over thousands of miles; ancient spies use invisible ink made from human sperm and write messages inside raw eggs; Japanese ninjas use explosives.

title: Ancient Discoveries
description:
S06 E08 — Ancient Special Forces
Ancient Roman Navy SEAL technique of capturing enemy ships from underwater; Roman war dog units; the Mastiff; the samurai sword; the Horo is designed to protect cavalryman from arrow fire.

title: Ancient Discoveries
description:
S06 E01 — Airborne Assault
Early methods of airborne attack; medieval kite bomb; bouncing bombs terrorize shipping in Turkey in 1453; Chinese commanders use whistling arrows to direct battles; Chinese rockets; the earliest known successful parachute.

title: Mail Call
description:
S04 E04 — Grease Gun; Sten Gun; E-3 Sentry AWACS; J-Stars; Vietnam Fire Support Bases; Charlie
Submachine guns; high-tech aerial command and control centers; fire support bases; slang term "Charlie."

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E01 — Japanese Katana
Bladesmiths have to forge one of the most iconic weapons from history, the Japanese Katana; their swords will be pushed to the absolute limit with the final test determining which is stronger.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E02 — Chakram
The finalists go to their home forges to create an ancient Indian Chakram, and they return with two very different interpretations of that deadly, circular throwing weapon; only one stands up to the judges' dynamic battery of tests.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E03 — Viking Battle Axe
The bladesmiths have to turn a steel train spring into a weapon of their choosing; only two competitors will move on and are given only five days to forge a legendary Viking Battle Axe.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E04 — Katar
Competitors make their signature blade by using the Hada technique, a traditional process that involves forging multiple layers of steel together.

title: Forged in Fire: Beat the Judges
description:
S01 E01 — Short Sword Damascus
Three champions return to the forge, hoping to defeat one of the three judges; after forging signature blades and a Khanda, one champion survives to enter their toughest challenge yet, competing against a judge.

title: Forged in Fire: Beat the Judges
description:
S01 E02 — Medieval Times
The competitors will have their signature blades tested before re-creating a medieval knight's dagger; in eight hours, it's seen if the remaining champion has the skills to re-create an arming sword worthy of beating a judge and winning $10,000.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E05 — Crusader Sword
Following a difficult first round of testing, the remaining two bladesmiths head home with only five days to forge the legendary Crusader Sword.
